# Tidier device settings: five tabs; the Android app asks before choosing a lone development server
### Changed
- **The "Edit device" dialog is tidied up: five tabs instead of one long form.** **General** (name, background, seconds per photo, zoom, portrait pairs), **Display** (arrangement of the overlays, weather place, appointments from phones, look-ahead days, the calendar link in a collapsed block), **Programme** (permanent programme, schedule, special photos, night rest), **Tablet** (tablet check, restart test, charge history, revoke access) and **More** (note, party with guest photos, greeting with photo, simple access, maintenance). No field was removed, each sits in exactly one tab.
- **Technical settings only in Expert view:** "Change type", "Identifier (Home Assistant)", "Image sharpness", the ADB route and "Connection link and QR code" now appear only under Settings → View → Expert. In the "Tablet" tab the standard view shows just the tablet check; the Fully hint belongs to Expert view.
### Fixed
- **Android app 1.4.2: a single development server is no longer chosen by itself.** The app only searches its own network. If the only server there was a development server (version "dev"), it connected to it although the real server was in another network. Now it asks in that case ("Development server found") and points out that you can type the address. With exactly one normal server it still connects by itself, with several it asks as before.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
